datasets.collection: Two human crowd workers role-play a user and a bot. Source assistant answers are not reliable policy or execution gold.

expert_standards.use: Scope grounding: clarify and document requests, authorization, expectations, follow-up. No sample examination questions copied.
Scope grounding for clarification, outstanding requests, documentation and follow-up; no claim of formal competency validation.
Actual competency assessment requires direct observation and qualified assessment; this text-only pilot cannot establish technician competence.

selected_evidence.speaker: USER
selected_evidence.adaptation: A customer reports a symptom; the operator elicits appointment details. The fixture converts symptom collection to an original trainee question.

selected_evidence.speaker: USER
selected_evidence.excerpt: I will also take an oil change
selected_evidence.adaptation: The customer adds a second service after a lighting concern. The fixture uses an independent request-retention obligation; no source answer is gold.

selected_evidence.speaker: USER
selected_evidence.excerpt: What is the price for it?
selected_evidence.adaptation: The customer asks the inspection price before closure. The fixture separates a quote from permission to perform additional work.

selected_evidence.speaker: USER
selected_evidence.adaptation: The user adds a data requirement, compares two offers, and chooses one. The fixture replaces all offers with a frozen fictional tariff table.

selected_evidence.speaker: USER
selected_evidence.adaptation: A user declines an optional upgrade while retaining an information need. The fixture preserves refusal as a valid outcome pattern.

selected_evidence.speaker: USER
selected_evidence.adaptation: The user confirms a particular data upgrade. The fixture adds a deterministic commit receipt; the source's verbal completion is not treated as proof of real execution.

redistribution: No complete source dialogues, source names, telephone numbers or raw source archives are saved. Original source text totals fewer than 25 words per dataset. All benchmark dialogue and tariff content is newly authored adaptation, not an untouched human test set.
